## About
Curtis Plumbing is a family owned and operated plumbing company serving Los Angeles and Ventura counties, with a location on Topanga Canyon Blvd in Woodland Hills.
We take care of plumbing repair for homes, businesses and industrial properties, from sewer inspection and drain cleaning to water heaters, toilets and faucets. We work with brands like Kohler, Toto, Moen, Grohe and American Standard.
Plumbing problems don't wait for business hours, so neither do we. You can call us any time of the day or night.
Our neighbors get to know our plumbers by name. One reviewer said Caine came out within the hour and gave them solutions they hadn't considered. Another said Chase Westwood listened first, told them what he was about to do, and cleaned up thoroughly afterward. We're rated 4.9 from 354 Google reviews.

## Services
- Sewer Inspection: Sewer line inspection for homes and businesses across Los Angeles and Ventura counties.
- Drain Cleaning: Drain cleaning for residential, commercial and industrial properties when things back up.
- Water Heaters: Help with water heaters for homes and businesses when the hot water stops.
- Leak Detection: Tracking down leaks in your plumbing so they can be fixed.
- Backflow: Backflow work for residential, commercial and industrial properties.
- Garbage Disposals: Garbage disposal service for when yours stops doing its job.
- Toilets: Toilet repair and replacement, including fixes to the flushing mechanism.
- Faucets: Faucet work for kitchens and bathrooms; one reviewer had Franky replace a touch less kitchen faucet.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Curtis Plumbing has 24 hour emergency service, so you can call anytime.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve the Los Angeles and Ventura counties, including Woodland Hills.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We provide plumbing repair for residential, commercial and industrial properties.

Q: What brands do you work with?
A: We use many brands, including Kohler, Toto, Moen, Grohe and American Standard.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Call Curtis Plumbing at 800-729-8149, or fill out the request form on our contact page.

## What customers say
- "★★★★★ If I could give Curtis Plumbing more than five stars, I would.

We had a serious problem with an upstairs toilet that resulted in water leaking through to the ceiling below. Chase Westwood from Curtis Plumbing arrived exactly on time and was exceptional from beginning to end.

Chase is a tall, big, powerful-looking man, yet remarkably quiet and soft-spoken. That combination turned out to characterize the way he worked: considerable capability without noise, drama, or fuss, clearly knowledgeable and confident in his work. He began by simply listening. We explained what had happened, what we had observed, and our concerns. Then he discussed options with us before beginning. There was no attempt to upsell a service we didn't need. However, after seeing how quickly he performed the toilet replacement, we asked him to do a second toilet replacement, which he agreed he had time to do.

What particularly impressed us was his communication while he worked. He was considerate: before shutting off water, using a torch, or doing anything that would create unexpected sounds, he told us what he was about to do. Then he simply got on with the work without requiring constant supervision or observation. He was not on his phone: he was on his knees doing the job!

Over approximately three hours, Chase repaired and replaced what was necessary, carefully tested everything himself, and then had us test it as well. While he was here, he also fixed the flushing mechanism on a third toilet. He cleaned up thoroughly afterward and even gave us useful advice about  finding replacement hardware for our showers (not the reason he was there).

Professional, efficient, courteous, meticulous, and remarkably unobtrusive. This is increasingly rare but exactly what you hope for when inviting a tradesperson into your home, especially when dealing with an urgent plumbing problem that has the potential to cause water damage, mold, and untold other consequences.

Curtis Plumbing earned every one of these five stars, and Chase Westwood deserves a sixth. We would call them again without hesitation and recommend them enthusiastically." (Lester D.R. Thompson, 5/5)
